messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] simmer for utilities plant simulations
parts:
Hi,

Do you mean power plants and the like? I'm not familiar with their
internal operation, but I suppose that it depends on what exactly you
want to simulate. If you want to simulate the energy production, using
a DES like simmer is not a good idea. On the other hand, if you want
to simulate pieces, equipment, machinery... and you are interested in
failure prediction, personnel for replacing and repairing parts and so
on, then yes, simmer is a good choice.

Regards,
Iñaki
